svg.aria-label: SafeHer: Decentralized women's safety app. One tap sends an SOS with live location to emergency contacts, evidence is stored on IPFS and recorded on Ethereum so nobody can quietly alter it, and a locally hosted AI chatbot gives crisis guidance.
